title: 污泥離心脫水
summary: 本課以離心場、相對螺旋速度與固體捕集為主線，從乾固體進料、離心加速度、螺旋相對速度、聚合物乾基換算進入十個相連的技術單元。每單元依機制、數量模型、驗證與失效辨識逐步操作，最後完成包含單位、敏感度及邊界的工程工作單。數值均為原創教學假設，不是特定設施實測或現場操作設定。
summaryEn: This course develops centrifugal field, differential scroll speed and solids capture through ten connected units, beginning with dry-solids feed, centrifugal acceleration, scroll differential speed, dry-basis polymer conversion. Each unit moves through mechanism, quantitative model, verification and failure diagnosis, ending in a worksheet with units, sensitivity and applicability. All example numbers are original teaching assumptions, not facility measurements or live operating settings.

steps.title: 乾固體進料：機制與觀察

steps.instruction: 脫水負荷以乾固體而非單看液體流量計，否則濃度變動被漏掉。

steps.instruction: 進料、泥餅、濾液三端乾固體應閉合，剩餘差額指向庫存或量測問題。
